endorsements.name: Mouad Abouhali
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-10882
endorsements.description: The Netskope client service, v57 before 57.2.0.219 and v60 before 60.2.0.214, running with NT\SYSTEM privilege, accepts network connections from localhost. The connection handling function in this service suffers from a stack based buffer overflow in "doHandshakefromServer" function. Local users can use this vulnerability to trigger a crash of the service and potentially cause additional impact on the system.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.0, 5.5)
